# Generated by OpenCode - Pyramid OS Architecture

## Boot Flow
```
UEFI/BIOS -> GRUB (pyramid theme #C9A84C / #1A1A1A)
         -> kernel linux-lts 6.12.x + initramfs (mkinitcpio)
         -> systemd 256+
            ├─→ sddm.service (if enabled, Law 2)
            │     → /usr/share/wayland-sessions/hyprland.desktop → Hyprland → quickshell -c bar
            └─→ getty@tty1 + autologin.conf (pyramid) → .zshrc exec Hyprland → bar
```
SDDM is a systemd service toggle. `sudo systemctl disable sddm` activates TTY autologin.

## Directory Tree (installed system)
```
/
├── boot/grub/themes/pyramid/theme.txt + background.png
├── etc/
│   ├── sddm.conf.d/pyramid.conf          # Law 2
│   ├── systemd/system/getty@tty1.service.d/autologin.conf
│   ├── calamares/branding/pyramid/*      # installer branding + settings.conf
│   ├── skel/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua    # copied to new users
│   ├── skel/.config/quickshell/bar/shell.qml
│   ├── skel/.config/ghostty/config
│   ├── skel/.zshrc
│   ├── pacman.conf                       # core+extra, multilib/chaotic-aur commented
│   └── hostname (pyramid)
├── usr/share/
│   ├── backgrounds/pyramid/pyramid-0{1..5}.jpg
│   ├── grub/themes/pyramid/theme.txt
│   └── sddm/themes/pyramid/ (falls back to breeze if missing)
└── home/pyramid/.config/ (== /etc/skel/.config after first user creation)
```

## Build Artifact Tree (repo)
```
Pyramid_OS_Code/  (repo root == $PROJECT_DIR for build.sh)
├── profiledef.sh + pacman.conf + packages.x86_64  → archiso profile
├── airootfs/  → overlay into ISO root (squashfs via customize_airootfs.sh)
│   ├── etc/skel/.config/{hypr,quickshell,ghostty}
│   ├── etc/sddm.conf.d, systemd autologin, calamares
│   └── usr/share/backgrounds/pyramid, grub/themes
├── build.sh  → mkarchiso wrapper (clean/iso/test/all/release)
├── airootfs/root/customize_airootfs.sh  → chroot: user pyramid, locale, services, keyring
├── grub/theme.txt  → source of truth, copied to two places in airootfs
├── calamares/branding/pyramid/  → also copied to airootfs/etc/calamares/...
├── plymouth/pyramid-theme/  → optional plymouth two-step theme
├── scripts/install.sh  → emergency CLI installer + pyramid-welcome.sh + fetch-wallpapers.sh
├── packages.*  → base (must) + recommended/dev (optional, Law 1)
└── out/*.iso + .sha256/.md5 (gitignored, produced by build.sh)
```

## Hyprland Config (hl Lua)
- `hl.monitor`, `hl.config { general, decoration, misc, input, dwindle }`
- `hl.curve` + `hl.animation { leaf, bezier, style }` — bezier required (Hyprland 0.56)
- `hl.dsp.exec_cmd("quickshell -c bar")` autostart + `hl.bind` for 40+ keybinds
- `hl.bind("SUPER+SPACE", "quickshell cmd launcher")` → built-in QML launcher

## QML Bar (quickshell/bar/shell.qml)
- `ShellRoot` with `PanelWindow` bar (launcher | time+cal | wifi | bt | bri | notif) + single overlay `panelLayer` + `launcher` overlay
- `NotificationServer` → `notifs[]` + DND toggle → bell icon
- Polling `Process` + `Timer` for bt/wifi/brightness/volume (volume via `wpctl`)
- `IconBtn` component with `activate`/`wheeled` signals → MouseArea onWheel
- Consistent rounding `root.round = 5` per user request

## Services
| Service | Live ISO | Installed | Toggle |
|---------|----------|-----------|--------|
| NetworkManager | enabled | enabled | `systemctl` |
| sddm | enabled | enabled | disable → TTY |
| bluetooth | disabled | disabled | enable |
| cups | disabled | disabled | enable |
| pipewire | user | user | user systemctl |

## Reproducibility (Law 4)
- package versions in `packages.x86_64` are not strictly pinned to exact versions (Arch rolling), but the file is the pin — same file + same mirror snapshot → same ISO. For strict pin, add `pacman -Q > manifest` in `build.sh release` and commit.
- No network during `customize_airootfs.sh` except `reflector` (best-effort).
- `mkarchiso` uses `pacman.conf` from repo root, not host.
